g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Provide reusable grocery-list templates that the user can customize for different occasion
s such as a weekly list and a party-planning list. → Complete routine online grocery order
s efficiently, without spending time exploring or browsing items.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Reduce the typing and clicking needed for each order by letting the user open one saved li
st and read through it instead of rebuilding the list. → Complete routine online grocery o
rders efficiently, without spending time exploring or browsing items.

g.aria-label: 待确认联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 待确认联系 · 实现方式
Every two weeks, show the user the grocery list for sign-off and then place the order for
pickup. → Complete routine online grocery orders efficiently, without spending time explor
ing or browsing items.

g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于

efficiently, without spending time exploring or browsing items.
